summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing regulatory approval (from OSFI and TSX) of a renewed normal course issuer bid (NCIB) to repurchase up to 10,000,000 common shares (~1.8% of shares outstanding). Purchases may occur via TSX, NYSE, or alternative platforms at market prices, with daily limits of 25% of ADTV (TSX: 502,034 shares) or prior 4-week average (NYSE). Shares will be cancelled or used for equity incentive arrangements. The NCIB runs from May 29, 2026 to May 28, 2027. An automatic repurchase plan is in place to facilitate purchases during blackout periods. The prior NCIB was fully utilized at an average price of C$83.33.
